signals.rationale: The recipient receives native currency on line 12 before its balance is reduced on line 14, so a recipient contract can reenter withdraw while the old balance remains visible.

finding.title: External value transfer precedes balance reduction
finding.severityRationale: A recipient contract can repeat withdrawals before the original balance reduction executes.
preconditions: the withdrawing recipient is a contract that reenters before its balance is reduced
the vault holds enough native currency for the repeated withdrawal
finding.potentialConsequence: The recipient can withdraw more native currency than its recorded balance.
finding.mitigation: Reduce the balance before the external call and enforce a reentrancy guard.
finding.validationMethod: Manual control-flow review of the frozen source confirmed the Slither signal.

signals.rationale: The call result on line 13 is discarded while attemptedPayments is incremented on line 14, so failed calls are recorded as attempts without any failure branch.

finding.title: Low-level payout result is ignored
finding.severityRationale: A failed target call does not prevent the contract from advancing its payment-attempt accounting.
preconditions: the owner invokes a target whose low-level call returns false
downstream accounting treats attemptedPayments as successful execution
finding.potentialConsequence: Off-chain or downstream logic can mistake a failed external call for a completed payment attempt.
finding.mitigation: Require the low-level call to succeed before updating accounting.
finding.validationMethod: Manual control-flow review of the frozen source confirmed the Slither signal.
